description: Desktop/package component scaffolds: elevate the empty print-statement stubs (and thin layouts) in the most relevant component scaffolds to coherent Arch/Omarchy-inspired functionality. Same change pattern across many files = one feature, one step per scaffold. Each step also extends that scaffold's README.md 'Upstream Reference' section to document the new behaviour (Phase-4 READMEs already carry that section). No new external dependencies; stdlib only for Python/Bash, zero-dep Rust matching each scaffold's existing style. FEAT-002 is independent of FEAT-001 (different files), so it may be done in either order, but execution is sequential per the workflow.
steps: Phase-3 SigmaOS-window-manager (own Cargo.toml): add src/layout.rs with DwindleLayout (recursive spiral split) and MasterStackLayout (master + stack) structs + a configurable LayoutConfig { gaps: u32, border_px: u32 }; add a 'layout_of(WmMode, &str)' selector; wire a 'pub mod layout;' into src/lib.rs and a layout-kind enum alongside the existing WmMode. Add inline tests for dwindle/master split geometry. Update README.md.

Phase-3 SigmaOS-compositor (own Cargo.toml): in src/lib.rs add an OutputLayoutBinding { output_name: String, kind: LayoutKind } (kinds: Dwindle, Master, Stacking) and a 'switch_layout(&mut self, output: &str, kind: LayoutKind)' method on WaylandServer; add inline tests. Update README.md.

Phase-3 SigmaOS-file-manager (own Cargo.toml; gtk4 optional/default-off): in src/search.rs add 'fuzzy_score(query: &str, name: &str) -> usize' (subsequence match + recency bonus, zero deps) and 'FileSearch::fuzzy_search(root: &Path, query: &SearchQuery) -> Vec<(PathBuf, usize)>' returning ranked results; add inline tests. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-packages-kit (Python, src/main.py): replace the single print line with an argparse CLI implementing a pacman-inspired Transaction model: install/remove/sync/resolve (topological dependency resolution over an in-memory package graph) and verify (checksum) subcommands, stdlib only (argparse, collections, json). Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-packages-tools (Python, src/main.py): replace the stub with an argparse CLI for package install/upgrade/verify-sig subcommands with an in-memory package record, stdlib only. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-quickshell (Python, src/main.py): replace the stub with an argparse CLI for a keyboard-driven fuzzy launcher: query/launch/list over a list of .desktop-style entries with a fuzzy score, stdlib only. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-reel (Python, src/main.py): replace the stub with an argparse CLI for omareel-style screen recording: 'record {region|display}' with output config (container/fps) and 'list', an in-memory recording record, stdlib only. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-plugin-marketplace (Python, src/main.py): replace the stub with an argparse CLI for an AUR-inspired trusted community marketplace: search/install with a trust_score and votes model over an in-memory catalogue, stdlib only. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-plugin-registry (Python, src/main.py): replace the stub with an argparse CLI for an AUR-inspired registry: register/list/resolve (name->version->source) over an in-memory registry, stdlib only. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-ISO (Shell, src/main.sh): extend the existing 'set -euo pipefail' script with archiso-inspired declarative ISO/profile building: 'build <profile>', 'profile list', and a 'makepkg-check' subcommand that validates the bundled pkgbuild/*.PKGBUILD shape (pkgname/pkgver/pkgrel present). Keep the existing usage/case structure. Update README.md (already references omarchy-iso).

Phase-4 SigmaOS-dots-configuration (Shell, src/main.sh): extend the existing omadots/chezmoi-inspired script with a declarative dotfile manifest (source->target map) and install/apply/backup/diff subcommands replacing the placeholder echoes; keep 'set -euo pipefail' and the DEST/usage scaffolding. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-mac-run (Shell, src/main.sh): replace the single echo with an omarchy-mac-inspired shims CLI: 'run <app>' (launch shim + env translation table), 'shim list', 'env list'; keep 'set -euo pipefail'. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-file-manager-system (Rust, has its own Cargo.toml): in src/lib.rs add a 'fuzzy_score(query: &str, name: &str) -> usize' and a 'FuzzyFinder' struct with find(name)->Vec<(String, usize)> ranked results, zero deps, matching the existing Mount/FileOp/FileManagerBackend style; add inline tests. Update README.md.

Phase-4 SigmaOS-screen-recorder (Rust, currently has NO Cargo.toml so 'cargo check' resolves up to the umbrella): extend src/lib.rs with CaptureRegion, RecorderConfig, and a Recorder state machine with start/stop; ADD a Cargo.toml mirroring SigmaOS-file-manager-system/Cargo.toml exactly: [package] name = "sigmaos-screen-recorder", version = "0.1.0", edition = "2021"; [lib] path = "src/lib.rs"; [dependencies] empty. Add inline tests. Update README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Phase-3 Rust scaffolds (window-manager, compositor, file-manager): 'cargo check' in each scaffold dir builds that scaffold's own package (NOT the umbrella 'sigmaos') with exit 0; 'cargo test' in each dir passes all inline tests.
Phase-4 Python scaffolds (packages-kit, packages-tools, quickshell, reel, plugin-marketplace, plugin-registry): 'python3 -m py_compile src/main.py' in each scaffold dir exits 0.
Phase-4 Shell scaffolds (ISO, dots-configuration, mac-run): 'bash -n src/main.sh' in each scaffold dir exits 0.

Phase-4 Rust scaffolds (file-manager-system, screen-recorder): 'cargo check' in each scaffold dir builds that scaffold's own package (file-manager-system and sigmaos-screen-recorder respectively, NOT the umbrella) with exit 0.
Each edited scaffold README.md retains and extends its 'Upstream Reference' section.
No new external dependencies are added anywhere (zero-dep Rust, stdlib-only Python/Bash).
verification: Phase-3 Rust: for d in SigmaOS-window-manager SigmaOS-compositor SigmaOS-file-manager; do (cd .agents/tasks/phase3-desktop/$d && cargo check && cargo test); done  -> all build and tests pass.

Phase-4 Python: for d in SigmaOS-packages-kit SigmaOS-packages-tools SigmaOS-quickshell SigmaOS-reel SigmaOS-plugin-marketplace SigmaOS-plugin-registry; do (cd .agents/tasks/phase4-components/$d && python3 -m py_compile src/main.py); done  -> all exit 0.
Phase-4 Shell: for d in SigmaOS-ISO SigmaOS-dots-configuration SigmaOS-mac-run; do (cd .agents/tasks/phase4-components/$d && bash -n src/main.sh); done  -> all exit 0.

Phase-4 Rust: for d in SigmaOS-file-manager-system SigmaOS-screen-recorder; do (cd .agents/tasks/phase4-components/$d && cargo check); done  -> both build their OWN package (not 'sigmaos') with exit 0. After verification, remove any Cargo.lock produced by 'cargo check' in those dirs so only source is committed.
Confirm umbrella still green after all scaffold edits: cargo check --lib  -> exit 0 (scaffold edits do not touch the umbrella crate).
